motion_rule: camera travels down the aisle alongside the hyena every beat, shelves streaming past frame; hyena covers ground in every beat, never planted; one action per beat; hyena head over a third of frame, new shot size each beat; motion across frame or at the lens, never up-down
character: spotted hyena, scruffy fur, no clothing at all, upright on hind legs with front paws free, fills two thirds of frame height, same look throughout
second_characters: ONE pelican and ONE goat, always a shoulder from the lens and crossing frame: the pelican at 0.00-1.30, 2.20-2.95 and 4.60-5.05, the goat shoving a second cart past the hyena at 1.30-2.20, 3.70-4.60 and 5.55-6.30
props: ONE giant party balloon, blank all over, nothing printed on it; ONE wheeled flatbed cart; A SWARM of paper streamers

light_events: daylight blazes from the windows; a streamer curtain swings loose at 5.55 and rakes a bright band across the hyena
